note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: What are the first names and birth dates of players from the USA?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name ,  birth_date FROM players WHERE country_code  =  'USA'

questions.question: Find the average rank of winners in all matches.
Find the number of distinct name of losers.
How many different loser names are there?
List the names of all winners who played in both 2013 and 2016.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE YEAR  =  2013 INTERSECT SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE YEAR  =  2016

questions.question: What are the country code and first name of the players who won in both tourney WTA Championships and Australian Open?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.country_code ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.winner_id WHERE T2.tourney_name  =  'WTA Championships' INTERSECT SELECT T1.country_code ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.winner_id WHERE T2.tourney_name  =  'Australian Open'

questions.question: What is the first name and country code of the player with the most tours?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.country_code ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id ORDER BY T2.tours DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Find the year that has the most number of matches.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT YEAR FROM matches GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Find the name of the winner who has the highest rank points and participated in the Australian Open tourney.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE tourney_name  =  'Australian Open' ORDER BY winner_rank_points DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the name of the winner with the most rank points who participated in the Australian Open tournament?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE tourney_name  =  'Australian Open' ORDER BY winner_rank_points DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the first names of all players, and their average rankings?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(ranking) ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name

questions.question: Find the total ranking points for each player and their first name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(ranking_points) ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name

questions.question: What are the first names of all players, and their total ranking points?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(ranking_points) ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name

questions.question: What are the codes of countries with more than 50 players?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT country_code FROM players GROUP BY country_code HAVING count(*)  >  50

questions.question: Find the number of matches happened in each year.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  YEAR FROM matches GROUP BY YEAR

questions.question: Find the number of left handed winners who participated in the WTA Championships.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT winner_name) FROM matches WHERE tourney_name  =  'WTA Championships' AND winner_hand  =  'L'

questions.question: Find the first name, country code and birth date of the winner who has the highest rank points in all matches.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.country_code ,  T1.birth_date FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.winner_id ORDER BY T2.winner_rank_points DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many players are there for each hand type?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  hand FROM players GROUP BY hand
